annotations.title: Average asking price of cars in Ireland for free

description: Free average, median, quartiles and price range by optional brand, model, exact year and area (county). Model requires brand. Exact case-insensitive make/model/county matching; omit all filters for Ireland. At least 5 valid positive finite asking prices are required: zero returns no_records and a clear no-records message; 1-4 returns limited_records and states the exact count, with null price stats. 10 attempts per UTC day per IP, shared across REST/MCP/A2A, separate from inventory and preview; invalid attempts count. After the limit, wait until midnight UTC; no automatic paid calls. Optional paid matching listings require explicit approval and x402 payment. Asking prices of recorded active fresh listings in Ireland (IE), not transaction prices or the whole market. Listings are not unique vehicles across sources. Area is an exact Irish county, not a town. Broad brand/model averages mix model years, fuels and trims and are not a vehicle valuation. Free (limited to 10 attempts per UTC day per IP, shared with REST; separate from inventory and preview).

area.description: Optional exact Irish county, not a town.

model.description: Optional exact model, case-insensitive; requires brand.

year.description: Optional exact model year, not a year range.
